cases.name: B3-1 single-scene QA never certifies a film (whole_film_pass false)
B3-2 automated gates pass; without a film review the verdict is FAIL
B3-3 positive path: film receipt after all gates → PRODUCTION_PASS_UNDER_TEST_TRUST (never plain PRODUCTION_PASS under test trust)
B3-4 rerun re-hashes: a replaced MP4 fails render and stales the film receipt
B3-5 negatives: missing shot, missing audio, stale art, 30-fps file, missing frame
B3-6 without test trust the same package is refused (diagnostic art, non-human reviews, synthetic render)
B1-a 640×900 master registered at 0.5×: canonical rect [-20,-15,320,450] and one full crop→canonical affine
B1-b every registered part: canonical rect = bbox of its four transformed crop corners (independent ground truth from the delivery transform)
B1-c the loader refuses a canonical rect that disagrees with its crop→canonical matrix
B1-d world plate at 2 px/unit: rect [-100,-60,1200,675]; footprint flags the wide view and passes the push-in; Chrome pixels agree
B1-e emitter applies scale/rotation/crop exactly once: interior source pixels land where crop→canonical predicts (0.5×, 1.25×+rot, 0.9×+rot, rot, sub-crop)
B1-f transition plates delivered at 2× density render like 1× plates (mask aperture, anchor and scale applied once)
B2-a the real Ines plan declares surface→underpaint ownership; plan validation refuses unmapped / non-underpaint / wrongly ordered owners
B2-b intake carries the ownership: forearm links pilot_underpaint, loader finds no MISSING_UNDERPAINT, unmapped plan refuses
B2-c hard elbow bend in Chrome: owned underpaint closes the joint; hiding it opens a seam
H1 planned alpha contract is enforced at intake (no silent rewrite)
H2 registration receipt content is verified and bound into the approval
H3 provider: model/size/config in the idempotency key; multiple outputs kept as immutable candidates; retry then resume
H4 review history is immutable; a rejection clears the current pointer; every decision survives
H5 API reviews are DIAGNOSTIC; production refuses non-human approvals; human attestation cannot be minted without an interactive operator
B2-d REAL Ines contract: forearm + elbow underpaint ingest with linked ownership and BELOW order; removing the link is refused
P0-1a every exported ArtJob whose triggers carry frames has non-empty motion_context.frame_ranges
P0-1b Ines master context covers the S02 interval and the master's shots
P0-1c perturbing S02 grip timing changes only dependent job contexts
P0-2a all six canonical-master jobs route to the canonical master medium
P0-2b routeMedium per typed kind; contradictory (state_kind, medium) refused
P0-3 intake API exists: ingest-master registers landmarks + identity hash; derived art refused before approval; kinds preserved
P0-4 production refuses random strings, foreign receipts, replaced PNGs, moved pivots, changed edges
P0-5 submit path: no provider → exact WAITING status and no file; stub server → receipts, decoded alpha, ancestry, idempotent
P0-6 fixture QA passes only the mechanical gate; production gate fails without audio and review
P0-1d world-camera footprint perturbation changes only that world's jobs; compiled master prompt hash follows

stateAtFrame is pure: random-order evaluation equals linear evaluation
grip and plant hold on every locked frame; no failures over the action
bend branch contradicting the FK pose is reported, not flipped silently
transform ownership, routing and morph topology are enforced at compile time
light plane is painted on its owner and under everything above the owner; reads the owner's matrix
every runtime element is written on every frame (seek-safe DOM state)
transition anchor is invariant; stages OUT→MIDDLE→IN
camera footprint flags exact spans when the camera outruns painted plates
gear ratio and flow symbols follow the declared mechanism
registration solver recovers similarity and affine exactly; collinear affine refused

state coverage: one static master for acting states never passes; front features on a turned head are missing
provider boundary: no configuration → NullProvider with an exact blocker; never fabricates
sprite emitter: image at (cx-px, cy-py), crop via nested viewport, static asset_to_canonical wrapper; missing asset refused
word cues: measured timing resolves exact frames; estimated timing or a broken cue → MISSING_WORD_ALIGNMENT
